name: Decap CMS
tagline: Open source Git-based CMS for static sites. The original Netlify CMS.
shortDescription: Decap CMS (formerly Netlify CMS) is an open source Git-based CMS. Add a static admin panel to any static site generator, edit Markdown/YAML/TOML, commit back to your repo.
longDescription:
## What it is

Decap CMS (formerly Netlify CMS) is an open source Git-based CMS. Drop a single HTML tag into your static site, and you get a full admin panel for editing Markdown, YAML, or TOML files. Commits go back to your Git repo.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a free, open source, Git-based CMS with no SaaS tier, Decap is the answer. It's the spiritual successor to Netlify CMS (renamed after Netlify acquired it and forked).

## When to use it

- Static sites that need a CMS
- Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro, Next.js (static export)
- Git-based content workflows
- When you want no SaaS dependency
installInstructions:
**Add to your static site:**
1. Create `/admin/index.html`
2. Load Decap CMS from CDN
3. Add a `config.yml` to define collections
4. Editors visit `/admin/`

**Auth:** GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or local (with decap-server).
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Use with any Git host.
